desc: Show the Custom Scoreboard outside SkyBlock.
If enabled, it will use that servers lines without adding any other special lines.
Makes the Scoreboard Update every Game Tick (50ms).
If not it updates every 250ms
<red>Enabling this can greatly reduce your FPS!</red>
How to create a custom title/footer:
The custom text uses an xml-like syntax, meaning you need to open and close specific elements to have them modified.
\<bold>Hello</bold> for example makes "Hello" bold.
Use \<bold>/\<strikethrough>/\<italic>/\<underlined>/\<obfuscated> to modify the text.
Use \<green> etc to get the predefined vanilla colors.
Use \<color #f38ba8> for custom colors.
Use \<gradient #color1 #color2> for gradients.
You can also customize speed and directions by defining dir:[LEFT/DOWN_RIGHT/...] or speed:[number] inside the \<gradient>.
There will soon be a website that helps you generating this.
